dataset.basecaller: dorado 1.0.0, dna_r10.4.1_e8.2_400bps_sup@v5.2.0 with 4mC/5mC/6mA models (default adapter trimming, no barcode trimming)
dataset.kit: native barcoding (SQK-NBD114-24/96), barcode NB13, inferred from the reads

barcode_note: about 90% of the reads in this run still begin and end with the native barcode construct (flank + NB13 + flank, about 46 bases at each end), because the reads were basecalled without a barcoding kit name. Trim them before any analysis, e.g. with dorado demux --kit-name SQK-NBD114-96 (it trims barcodes by default), Porechop_ABI or ontrim. They are not counted in the artefact classes below.
